script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Drama
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

Title: THE HEIGHTS OF AMBITION

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

A dimly lit living room. MARTIN, 35, sits on the couch, staring blankly at an empty beer bottle. His wife, JESSICA, 33, enters from the kitchen, holding a tray with two glasses of wine.

JESSICA
(softly)
Hey, love. Is everything okay?

Martin, still not looking at her, shakes his head.

MARTIN
No. I got a call from work today. They're considering layoffs.

Jessica sits next to him and wraps her arm around him.

JESSICA
But they said you've been doing great. What could they possibly want to change?

Martin looks at her, frustration in his eyes.

MARTIN
I don't know. But I do know one thing. I can't afford to lose this job.

JESSICA
(concerned)
Why not? We have savings. We could survive for a while.

MARTIN
(scoffs)
Savings? We're barely making ends meet as it is. And with the interest rates on our loans, every penny counts. We can't afford to lose any income.

Jessica looks sympathetic but determined.

JESSICA
Well, then we'll find a way. We've faced challenges before and come out stronger.

Martin looks at her, his expression softening.

MARTIN
I know. But this time it feels different. I'm not just afraid for us. I have responsibilities. I have a family to provide for.

Jessica nods, understanding his concern.

JESSICA
Then we'll find a solution. Together.

INT. MARTIN'S OFFICE - DAY

Martin sits at his desk, staring at his computer screen. A knock at the door interrupts his thoughts. His boss, SARAH, enters.

SARAH
Martin, can I have a word with you?

Martin looks up, his heart racing.

MARTIN
Of course. Please, have a seat.

Sarah sits down in the chair across from him, her expression serious.

SARAH
Martin, I have some news. Our department is facing some financial challenges. And as much as I hate to say this, we may have to consider some layoffs.

Martin's heart sinks.

MARTIN
(nervously)
I see. And what does that mean for me?

Sarah hesitates, her expression sympathetic.

SARAH
I'm sorry, Martin. Your position is one of the ones we're considering for elimination.

Martin's world comes crashing down around him.

MARTIN
(whispers)
What? Why?

Sarah looks at him with regret.

SARAH
It's not about your performance, Martin. It's about the bottom line.

Martin's mind races, trying to come up with a solution.

MARTIN
(desperate)
Is there anything I can do? Anything at all?

Sarah shakes her head.

SARAH
I wish there was. But the budget is the budget. I'll give you until the end of the week to gather your things and turn in your keys and access cards.

Martin's eyes fill with tears as Sarah leaves the room.

INT. MARTIN'S HOME OFFICE - NIGHT

Martin sits at his computer, searching for jobs online. His mind is a whirlwind of anxiety and fear.

MARTIN
(to himself)
Come on. You can do this. You've faced challenges before. You've always come out on top.

He clicks on a job posting for a marketing position at a local firm. As he reads through the requirements, his heart sinks. He doesn't have the necessary experience.

MARTIN
(frustrated)
What am I going to do? How am I going to provide for my family?

Jessica enters the room, carrying a tray with two glasses of water.

JESSICA
Hey, love. You look upset. What's going on?

Martin looks at her, his eyes filled with despair.

MARTIN
I didn't get the job.

Jessica sits down next to him, her expression sympathetic.

JESSICA
Another one?

Martin nods, tears streaming down his face.

MARTIN
Yeah. I don't know what to do. We're out of options.

Jessica puts her arm around him, offering him a comforting squeeze.

JESSICA
We're not out of options, Martin. We'll find a way. We always do.

INT. MARTIN'S FATHER'S WORKSHOP - DAY

Martin and his father, HENRY, work on a car engine together. Henry looks up from his work, a proud expression on his face.

HENRY
You know, son, when I was your age, I isnt' had much. But I worked hard, and I made something of myself.

Martin looks at him, determined.

MARTIN
I'm going to do the same, Dad. I'm going to provide for my family, no matter what.

Henry smiles, his eyes filled with pride.

HENRY
That's the spirit, Martin.

INT. MARTIN'S HOME OFFICE - NIGHT

Martin sits at his computer, typing away at a business plan for a small landscaping company. He's determined to make it work, no matter what.

INT. MARTIN'S GARAGE - DAY

Martin works on a landscaping project for a neighbor, his muscles aching but his spirit unbroken. He looks up as Jessica approaches, carrying a tray of sandwiches and waters.

JESSICA
Hey, love. You look tired.

Martin smiles, his face covered in dirt.

MARTIN
I am, but I'm making progress.

Jessica sits down next to him, offering him a sandwich.

JESSICA
That's all that matters.

Martin takes a bite, his heart filled with gratitude for his wife and his determination to make a better future for them.

INT. MARTIN'S HOME OFFICE - NIGHT

Martin sits at his computer, his business plan complete. He prints out copies and begins making phone calls to potential clients. His phone rings, and he answers it, his heart racing.

MARTIN
(into phone)
Martin Spears, Spears Landscaping. How can I help you?

A voice on the other end offers him a landscaping job. Martin's heart leaps with joy and relief.

MARTIN
(into phone)
I'd be happy to help you out.

INT. MARTIN'S LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Martin and Jessica sit on the couch, surrounded by their children, laughing and playing games. Martin looks at his family, his heart filled with love and gratitude.

MARTIN
(softly)
We made it, Jessica. We really did it.

Jessica smiles, her eyes filled with pride.

JESSICA
We did, Martin. And we'll keep climbing.

Martin nods, his determination stronger than ever. Together, they will face whatever challenges come their way and keep reaching for the heights of ambition.

THE END.
